subject: Next steps: procurement timeline & mutual action plan for AcmeCloud
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-01T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + next steps from today's demo / procurement path questions

Hi Aisha — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap + a couple of questions so we can align on the commercial path and a simple mutual action plan (MAP).

Recap
- AcmeCloud needs production-grade inference for customer-facing features (latency SLOs ~200ms p99).
- Preferred model family: open Llama variants; interested in Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput.
- Key internal stakeholders: procurement (Jade), security (team), finance (PO/billing).

Questions / options we discussed
1) Commercial path: do you expect to purchase via PO (preferred by your procurement) or will you use corporate card / marketplace listing?
2) Marketplace: are you interested in us listing in the AcmeCloud marketplace, or would you prefer a direct contract first?
3) Timeline: what is a realistic timeline for legal review, security review, and finance PO issuance on your side?

Suggested next steps (proposed MAP)
- 3/03: Share draft SOW + contract stub (attached). Action: Camila (Redwood)
- 3/04–3/10: Legal review & redlines. Action: Marcus (Redwood) / Acme legal
- 3/04–3/17: Security questionnaire & evidence exchange (SOC2, architecture diagram). Action: Neha (Redwood) / Acme security
- 3/10–3/20: Finance/procurement issue PO and confirm billing. Action: Marissa (Redwood) / Jade (Acme procurement)

Attachments: AcmeCloud-MAP-v1.pdf (draft MAP), SOW-Redwood-v0.3.docx (contract + SOW stub)

Please confirm: (a) PO vs card, (b) marketplace interest, and (c) whether those milestone dates look reasonable for your team. Happy to jump on a 20-min alignment call if helpful.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acmecloud.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jade Miller <procurement@acmecloud.com>, AcmeCloud Security <security@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's demo / procurement path questions

Thanks Camila — great demo and clear notes. Quick answers below and a couple of clarifying items from procurement.

1) Commercial path: We will purchase via PO. Our procurement team prefers vendor contracts + a PO; corporate card is only for < $5k transactions.
2) Marketplace: not required at this stage. We prefer establishing a direct contract + PO for our initial deployment. We may revisit marketplace later.
3) Timeline: high-level estimate from our side:
   - Legal review & redlines: 7–14 business days (depends on redlines)
   - Security review & questionnaire: 10–21 business days (SOC2 evidence collection may add time)
   - Finance / procurement (PO issuance): ~7–10 business days after legal approval

We've looped in Jade from procurement (cc'd). Jade — I've attached our standard PO template (PDF) and our procurement intake form. Can you confirm the required billing contact and preferred invoicing cadence?

Action items for Redwood: please provide the contract stub and any SOC2 / security docs we can share with our security team (architecture diagram, SOC2 summary).

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Head of Product, AcmeCloud
aisha.khan@acmecloud.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-03T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's demo / procurement path questions

Appreciate the clarity, Aisha — PO path noted. I've updated the MAP and attached v2. Key clarifications and next steps from our side: 

- We'll proceed with a PO-based commercial path. Marketplace deferred.
- Attachments sent: AcmeCloud-MAP-v2.pdf (updated milestones), SOW-Redwood-v0.3.docx (original contract stub), SOC2-summary.pdf (security evidence summary), infra-arch.png (architecture diagram).

Updated MAP (high level)
- 3/03: Redwood shares updated MAP + contract stub (done) — Owner: Camila
- 3/04–3/10: Legal review & initial redlines — Owner: Marcus (Redwood) / Acme legal
- 3/04–3/18: Security questionnaire & evidence exchange — Owner: Neha (Redwood) / Acme security
- 3/11–3/20: Finance/procurement finalize PO issuance (target PO by 3/20) — Owner: Marissa (Redwood) / Jade (Acme)

Request for Acme: if you can share the primary legal contact (name + email) and any standard contract terms you require (e.g., insurance limits, data residency language), Marcus will take the first pass on redlines and aim to return a tracked draft within 3 business days after he receives Acme's legal input.

If helpful, we can schedule a 20-minute legal handoff with Marcus + Neha + your procurement/legal reps to walk through the contract and security checklist.

Thanks — I'll monitor for the PO template from Jade and send a contract with comments ready for review.

Best,
Camila

From: Jade Miller <procurement@acmecloud.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-05T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's demo / procurement path questions

Camila / Aisha — attaching AcmeCloud PO template and procurement intake form (attached). Billing contact: please list accounts-payable@acmecloud.com and reference our internal project code ACME-ML-2026 on invoices. Invoicing cadence: Net 30 preferred.

We do not require a marketplace listing for this purchase. Once legal confirms terms and security sign-off is complete, procurement will issue a PO. Expect procurement to prioritize once we have redlines returned from Redwood and SOC2 evidence attached.

Jade Miller
Senior Procurement Manager, AcmeCloud
procurement@acmecloud.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acmecloud.com>, Jade Miller <procurement@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2026-03-07T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps from today's demo / procurement path questions

I'll take the legal lead here. Camila — can you send the most recent contract stub (SOW-Redwood-v0.3.docx) into DocuSign / our redlines tracker or drop the file link? I'll do an initial pass for standard Redwood terms + any adjustments for PO-based billing.

Marissa — FYI on billing contact (accounts-payable@acmecloud.com) and Net 30. Neha — I'll coordinate with you on the SOC2 evidence pack; please confirm when SOC2-summary.pdf and infra diagram are shared to the Acme security mailbox.

Plan: aim to return a redlined contract to Acme legal within 3 business days after we receive their legal contact + any required non-standard terms. That keeps the MAP target (PO by 3/20) intact if all parties move promptly.

Attachment: Redwood-legal-next-steps.pdf (high-level checklist)

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
